# Spend ledger — 2026-10 (SIG-OPS-009; P34.5)

Monthly ledger row-set for October 2026. Schema and rules:
[`SPEND_LEDGER.md`](SPEND_LEDGER.md); machine-readable rows:
[`spend_ledger.csv`](spend_ledger.csv); agent usage:
[`agent_usage.csv`](agent_usage.csv).

## Cost rows

| surface | provider | line | amount (USD) | label | evidence / note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| infrastructure | GCP | all deployed services | ~90–100 | **estimate** | list-price inference from the deployed configuration ([NEXT_PHASE_PLAN](../../planning/2026-09-30-next-phase/NEXT_PHASE_PLAN.md) §10.4) — superseded, not edited, when export rows land |
| infrastructure | GCP | billing export per-service rows | — | **pending** | `gcp_billing_export_v1_<billing-account>` in `sig_billing_export` holds no rows until the OP-12 console link exists (D-P34.5-2); the monthly report leg is D-P34.5-3 |
| object hosting + CDN | Cloudflare R2 | usage + egress | — | **pending** | outside-cloud-account; operator-reported figure owed at the first monthly report |
| registrar/domains | Squarespace | `surveillancegraph.org` | — | **pending** | outside-cloud-account; operator-reported figure owed at the first monthly report |

**Assumptions carried (B-11):** the Cloud SQL 40 GB autoresize cap set by P34.3
bounds the worst-case storage line; the ceiling budget watches the realised
total, so the cap is an assumption about the envelope, not a measured figure.
